cardholder_prompt_data.description: Answers to prompts presented to cardholder at point of sale.

purchase_type.description: The type of purchase. One of `fuel_purchase`, `non_fuel_purchase`, or `fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase`.

reported_breakdown.description: More information about the total amount. This information is not guaranteed to be accurate as some merchants may provide unreliable data.

service_type.description: The type of fuel service. One of `non_fuel_transaction`, `full_service`, or `self_service`.
